title: Onramp coordinator docket - customer integration sync
content:
Weekly SE + ProServices sync - Onramp coordinator docket
Date: 2028-09-14
Attendees: Aisha (lead), Luca, Jamal, Hana, Oliver, Maia (CS), Ben (SRE - partial)
Duration: 40m
Purpose: Rapid status check across active integrations, surface blockers, agree next actions and owners. Informal notes + tactical asks for engineering.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / green updates (2m each)
- Customer deep-dive (ArborRetail, BlueOwl Fin, PioneerEd) (20m)
- Capacity/infra flags and upcoming maintenance (5m)
- Open risk table + runbook triggers (5m)
- Actions and owners (5m)

Top-line summary:
- Two customers (ArborRetail, BlueOwl Financial) on schedule for production cutover next week pending small infra fixes. PioneerEd delayed due to model-variant unexpected latency on long-form Q&A flows.
- Load test with ArborRetail hit an unexpected KV-cache miss pattern; mitigated by temporary routing to a warmed pool. Permanent fix in progress (PR linked).
- SRE flagged a noisy GPU OOM pattern during burst tests; root cause suspected in batch aggregation logic (INFRA-8742).

Customer blocks & status (current sprint):
1) ArborRetail (onramp stage: final verification)
- What: Retail recommendation endpoint + personalization session affinity.
- Current status: Integration tests green; final perf gating requires 95th-pct latency < 120ms for 512-token profiles.
- Blockers: KV-cache warmup shows 12% cold-hit rate causing tail latency spikes at 95th. Causes: prefix caching policy misapplied for pinning session keys.
- Recent actions: Luca patched routing to use warmed pool for canary traffic; load test scaled to 200 RPS (see test logs).
- Next: Jamal to land PR (runtime/prefix-cache-fix) by 2028-09-15 end of day; SRE to run 3x 20m bursts 2028-09-16 morning. If tail latency remains >120ms, fallback plan is to reduce batch size and enable strict per-session pinning (will increase cost).
- Owner(s): Jamal (fix), Maia (customer comms), Ben (SRE validation)

2) BlueOwl Financial (onramp stage: data/security review -> capacity provisioning)
- What: Private deployment (VPC + HSM) with Dedicated pool for transaction-large retriever model.
- Current status: Security review passed; provisioning blocked on subnet peering request and quota bump for reserved GPUs in us-east-2.
- Blockers: Cloud quota increases delayed by finance sign-off; anticipated 3 business day lag. Also need explicit KMS ARN mapping for audit logs (customer compliance requirement).
- Recent actions: Solutions engineering filed infra quota request INFRA-8742 and provided KMS mapping template to customer.
- Next: Aisha to escalate quota with cloud accounts team 2028-09-15. Hana to finalize KMS mapping and share sample audit artifact with BlueOwl. Target: provision by 2028-09-19.
- Owner(s): Aisha (quota escalation), Hana (KMS), Customer TPM (BlueOwl)

3) PioneerEd (onramp stage: model tuning & quality)
- What: Long-form student question answering + citation reranking; heavy long-context attention patterns.
- Current status: Post-integration evals show periodic hallucination regressions after quantization profile applied. Latency is within SLO but quality regression fails automated evals.
- Blockers: Quantized variant (int8) shows subtle tokenization discrepancies with training preprocess; causes mismatch in attention masking behavior.
- Recent actions: SE created repro harness, isolated case to a tokenization-padding edge-case. Oliver working on decoder-fix branch.
- Next: Oliver to open PR with unit test added by 2028-09-16. Until merged, we will keep customer on non-quantized variant to preserve quality. Customer notified; they accept temporary cost delta.
- Owner(s): Oliver (fix), Jamal (evals), Maia (customer comms)

Infra & capacity notes:
- SRE observed intermittent GPU memory reclaim delays during our nightly maintenance window (reported INFRA-8742). Impact: small number of Dedicated pools experienced stutter during eviction; mitigated by transient fallback to hosted API.
- Planned maintenance: kubernetes control-plane upgrade in us-west-1 on 2028-09-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Action: notify customers with Dedicated capacity. Aisha to send outbound email 2028-09-15.
- Capacity forecast: reserved capacity requests up 18% month-over-month due to three upcoming enterprise cutovers (incl BlueOwl). Recommend opening a 10% burst reserve for next two weeks. Finance sign-off needed.

Open risks and runbook triggers (brief):
- Risk: Persistent 95th-pct latency > SLO for paying customers during onboarding.
  - Runbook trigger: If 95th > target for > 3 consecutive 10m windows, engage on-call SRE + SE lead and apply immediate mitigations: route to warmed pools, disable aggressive batching, or route to smaller sequence-length model.
- Risk: KMS mapping mismatch causes failed audit during customer pen-test.
  - Runbook: On alert, stop connection, snapshot logs, hand off to security+customer success for coordinated disclosure.
- Risk: Quality regression from quantization.
  - Runbook: Pin traffic to unquantized model, open rollback PR, and run focused evaluate-suite with customer prompt set within 12 hours.

Tactical asks for engineering (short):
- Runtime team: expedite acceptance of prefix-cache patch (PR 4387). Test target: 3x 20m bursts at 200 RPS pass by EOD 2028-09-16.
- Infer-ops: provide a one-line config flag to pin session-key prefix caching into pool (temporary hotfix) that SE can toggle per-route. Estimated effort: ~4 hours.
- Quantization engineers: include additional tokenization-consistency checks in CI for int8 builds (low effort; prevents PioneerEd regression).

Decisions made in meeting:
- Keep PioneerEd on non-quantized model until fix merged.
- Approve temporary warmed-pool routing for ArborRetail for cutover.
- Escalate BlueOwl GPU quota as high priority to avoid slipping provisioning window.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Jamal: land runtime/prefix-cache-fix PR by 2028-09-15 EOD. (blocked: code review)
- Ben (SRE): run 3x 20m bursts and validate tail latency 2028-09-16 09:00 UTC; report within channel.
- Aisha: escalate cloud quota for BlueOwl and send Dedicated maintenance notice by 2028-09-15.
- Hana: finalize KMS ARN mapping and supply audit sample to BlueOwl 2028-09-16.
- Oliver: open decoder-fix PR + unit test (PioneerEd) 2028-09-16.
- Maia: customer emails & status updates for ArborRetail, PioneerEd, BlueOwl by 2028-09-15.

Parking lot / unresolved questions:
- Should we offer temporary cost credit to PioneerEd for keeping them on a higher-cost non-quantized variant? Finance ask (Aisha) to estimate impact.
- Can infra provide a one-click toggle in Console for warmed-pool routing per route? (Feature ask for Console + Runtime teams)

Quick notes & fragments captured during meeting (informal):
- Jamal: "cache warming pattern spikes only on Friday traffic shape; looks like batch alignment with CSV importer"
- Hana: "BlueOwl needs an HSM audit report sample - I can fake one for now but want to keep realistic"
- Oliver: "decoder edge-case only happens when padding tokens mix with soft-prompts; likely minor but needs test coverage"

Next sync: 2028-09-21 10:00 UTC (same channel)
Optional: SE leads to post an async status update in #se-onramp after critical tasks complete.

End of docket.

Document notes: informal working doc — will be copied to customer-facing playbook after final decisions and post-cutover notes.
